trial-registry: independent handles preserve one immutable decision across retries and reopening
separate processes contend for the same durable subject
a changed key or reference cannot treat the original namespace as empty
entitlement: first protected verified entry is atomic, expires at 120 hours, and respects paid and suspension precedence
durable recovery preserves the decision through lost responses, missing mirrors and replacement identities
review preserves conflicting evidence and valid paid access, and rechecks are audited
suspension and session revocation during registry I/O prevent granting access
